{{Current events|year=2018|month=11|day=7|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[Jean-Claude Arnault]], [[Nobel Prize in Literature#2018 controversy and award cancellation|Postponement of the 2018 Nobel Prize in Literature]]
**[[Jayne Svenungsson]] announces she is leaving the [[Swedish Academy]], the body that awards the [[Nobel Prize in Literature]]. She is the eighth person to quit amid sex abuse and financial crime scandals at the exclusive group. [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2018/11/07/world/europe/ap-eu-sweden-nobel.html (AP via ''The New York Times'')]
*[[Premiership of Justin Trudeau]], [[History of the Jews in Canada]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] issues an [[Public apology|apology]] for [[Canada|the country]]'s role in turning away the {{MS|St. Louis}}, a ship carrying over 900 [[Expulsions and exoduses of Jews|Jewish refugees]] [[Jews escaping from German-occupied Europe|fleeing]] persecution in [[Nazi Germany]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46105488 (BBC)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/trudeau-to-apologize-for-canadas-rejection-of-a-boat-full-of-jewish-refugees-in-1939/2018/11/07/5462d53a-e1f9-11e8-a1c9-6afe99dddd92_story.html (Washington Post)]
;Disasters and accidents
*Authorities find the bodies of two other men in the two collapsed buildings in [[Marseille]], [[France]], two days ago, bringing the death toll to six. [https://www.thejournal.ie/four-found-dead-in-collapsed-buildings-in-marseille-france-as-search-continues-4327328-Nov2018 (''The Journal.ie'')]
*A pair of buses collide on a road between [[Harare]] and [[Rusape]], [[Zimbabwe]], killing at least 47 people. [https://www.enca.com/news/47-killed-zimbabwe-bus-crash (e News Channel Africa)]

;Law and crime
*An unidentified attacker fatally shoots Benjamin Ramos, a [[Philippines]] lawyer opposing [[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]]'s [[Philippine Drug War|war on drugs]], in [[Kabankalan]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/11/07/world/asia/philippine-lawyer-duterte.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Asia Bibi blasphemy case]]
**[[Pakistan]]i Christian woman Asia Bibi, sentenced to death by [[hanging]] in 2010 and recently acquitted, is released from prison. Bibi has reportedly boarded a plane; however, its destination was not known. Several countries have offered her asylum. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-46130189 (BBC)]
*[[Thousand Oaks shooting]]
**At least 12 people, including a police sergeant, are killed while ten others are injured by a gunman at the Thousand Oaks Borderline Bar and Grill in [[Thousand Oaks]], [[California]] at around 11:15 PM PST ([[UTC-8]]). The gunman committed suicide at the end of the attack after a stand-off with police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46135459 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations|Trump administration dismissals and resignations]]
**[[Jeff Sessions]] resigns as [[United States Attorney General]] at the request of President [[Donald Trump]]. [[Matthew Whitaker (politician)|Matthew Whitaker]], Sessions' chief of staff, is appointed acting Attorney General. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/nov/07/jeff-sessions-fired-us-attorney-general (''The Guardian'')]
